name: stripe
description: Read and manage Stripe customers, charges, invoices, and subscriptions using a (preferably restricted) API key. Load for billing lookups, searches, and, with care, creating records.

content.inline:
## Stripe
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.stripe.com/v1` with `bearerSecret: "s/STRIPE_KEY"`. Prefer a restricted key (Developers -> API keys -> Create restricted key), read-only unless writes are needed; avoid the live secret key when a restricted one will do. Request bodies are form-encoded (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), not JSON. Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- Customers: `GET /customers?limit=100` (page with `starting_after={last id}`); one: `GET /customers/{id}`
- Search: `GET /customers/search?query=email:'a@b.com'`
- Charges / intents: `GET /charges?limit=100`, `GET /payment_intents?limit=100`
- Invoices / subscriptions: `GET /invoices?status=open`, `GET /subscriptions?status=active`
- Balance: `GET /balance`
- Create customer: `POST /customers` form body `email=a@b.com&name=Ada`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{error: {type, code, message}}`. 401 = bad key; `card_error` / `invalid_request_error` explain the problem in `message`.
- Amounts are in the smallest currency unit (cents); timestamps are Unix seconds.
- Page with `limit` + `starting_after`; never assume one call returns everything.
- Treat POST calls as real money operations - confirm intent before creating or modifying anything in live mode.
